spec_match.rationale: Sends real headers via WebTransportOptions on a genuine connection attempt and reads transport.responseHeaders entries after ready — the exact two surfaces the feature adds — with the responseHeaders-absent case honestly distinguished even when a session establishes.

interactive.rationale: Editable endpoint and two header fields; connect and close buttons; status and header list update from the real attempt.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises failures as first-class results; the status line delivers the browser's actual error verbatim with realistic causes.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles WebTransport-absent, 10s ready timeout, handshake failure (observed live), established-without-attribute, null-after-ready, and empty reply headers as distinct outcomes.

conformance.rationale: The suite's request-headers-reach-server manual assertion names this lab as its procedure.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: a real connection attempt to echo.webtransport.day produced the genuine 'WebTransportError: Opening handshake failed' (QUIC egress is blocked in this sandbox) surfaced verbatim with honest framing; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for read-success, established-without-attribute, and honest connect failure.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; ok/err status colours on stone (AA); ≥44px inputs.

accessibility.rationale: All three fields labelled; status and header list aria-live; buttons manage disabled state.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column stack with wrapping outputs; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Complete the loop on an H3-capable network with the flag
openQuestions.detail: This sandbox blocks outbound QUIC, so establishment is unreachable. On a normal network with Chrome 153 + WebTransportHeaders, connect to the echo server and verify the responseHeaders listing populates (and, with a logging endpoint, that the authorization header arrived).

guidanceConsulted.query: endpoint and header inputs labelled connect flow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label connection parameters and keep the primary action explicit.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Three labelled fields; connect/close as native buttons with state management.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async outcomes with full text, not colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status is aria-live and carries the browser's error text plus causes.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the lab performs a genuine handshake attempt and surfaces the real WebTransportError from this sandbox's blocked QUIC egress, exactly as designed. The established-path read needs a reachable H3 endpoint plus the flag and is recorded.
